newsitem.title: USA: NY regulators release Con Edison decision.
newsitem.headline: NY regulators release Con Edison decision.

text.p: A New York Public Service Commission Administrative Law Judge Judith Lee has released a recommendation on Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc's restructuring settlement agreement, commission spokesman Ed Collins said.

The commission decided May 20 to get formal administrative law judge decision on the settlements the commission staff had reached with Con Edison, Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc, Central Hudson Gas and Electric Corp and Rochester Gas and Electric Corp.
Prior to that, the consideration schedule called for an informal opinion for the law judges.

When the schedule was changed, the commission said that "once a recommended decision is issued publicly, the active parties in the case will have 20 days to submit briefs on exceptions and 15 days to subject briefs opposing exceptions."
With this schedule, it will be more than a month before the full commission takes up the Con Edison agreement.
In May, the commission said it expected the proposed settlement to come to the commission for settlement in August and September. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
